dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible on the posterior-lateral flank are several high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. The most prominent is a heart-shaped annulus with a sharp, defined gradient transitioning from a dark charcoal perimeter to a light grey interior. Smaller surrounding rings exhibit more diffused, less defined outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, irregular light-grey clusters concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and shoulder. These clusters lack internal structural gradients and appear as asymmetrical speckling against the darker primary coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the right posterior flank form a visible obtuse scalene triangle, with the most posterior point corresponding to the heart-shaped structure.
